known_differences: Tool results are wrapped in <untrusted_tool_result> with a 'treat as data' preamble; no switch (D20)
Malformed tool-call JSON is repaired and run (or run with {} if unrepairable); the model is never told. The adapter counts each repair from Hermes's log (D18)
Hermes's identity and runtime text surround the task system prompt (D20)
Replayed tool-call arguments are re-serialised with sorted keys
Non-chat GET requests to the proxy host (Ollama and /models probes) on every trial
